name: 3D Block Stitching and Resampling
aliases: Stitching and resampling for 3D block construction
definition: Stitching and resampling performed directly on the 3D target grid of the requested block to avoid aliasing.
summary: 3D Block Stitching and Resampling constructs volumetric blocks from 2D tiles by separating 2D pre-filtering from GPU-based Voronoi depth testing to resolve overlaps without blending.
